def span(shts, start, time):
    i = 1
    while start + i < len(shts):
        if shts[start + i] - shts[start] > time:
            return i
        i += 1
    return i

def main():
    qtty = int(input())
    shts = []
    for _ in range(qtty):
        aux = int(input())
        shts.append(aux)
    ts = int(input())
    shts.sort()
    maxspan = 0
    for i in range(len(shts)):
        aux = span(shts, i, ts)
        if maxspan < aux:
            maxspan = aux
    print(maxspan)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
